claim: DTU currently offers one English first-year full BSc, General Engineering.
excerpt: Structured restatement: The catalogue distinguishes the English full BSc from Danish BSc and BEng degrees, individual English courses and exchange study. Current portfolio has no 2027-specific guarantee.

claim: DTU is a self-governing technical university founded in 1829.
excerpt: Structured restatement: About DTU names technical and natural science, sustainability, a business-oriented approach, independent and self-governing university status, and its foundation in 1829.

claim: Lyngby and Ballerup serve different DTU study contexts.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Lyngby is 15 km north of Copenhagen, a 106-hectare landscaped site. Ballerup is 10 km west and home to many BEng students. DTU also has campuses and research facilities elsewhere; the General Engineering programme locates its teaching at Lyngby.

claim: General Engineering is a three-year English BSc at Lyngby with four specialisations and design-build projects.
excerpt: Structured restatement: All courses are English; about 60% of students are international. Year one combines maths, programming, physics, chemistry, biotechnology and design-build projects and introduces at least two specialisations. Choose by year two: Living Systems, Advanced Materials, Cyber Systems or Future Energy. Year three has optional exchange/company projects and a sixth-semester bachelor project. Most graduates continue to an MSc; each MSc has its own prerequisites.

claim: DTU accepts a 24-point IB Diploma with specific subject and English requirements.
excerpt: Structured restatement: IB Diploma at least 24 points qualifies. Only retakes of an originally unpassed exam are accepted. Danish subjects: Mathematics A, English B, Physics B, Chemistry B. A qualifying IB Diploma plus passed English equivalent to Danish B/A exempts the language test. Otherwise IELTS Academic 6.5, Cambridge C1/C2 180, TOEFL iBT 88 or 4.5 for exams after 21 January (year unstated). Online-verifiable certificates only; IELTS/TOEFL remain verifiable on 5 July; no IELTS One Skill Retake; TOEFL recipient 1684.

claim: DTU subject equivalences require maths HL and allow physics, chemistry and English at SL.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Table dated 19 February 2025: Mathematics AA HL or AI HL corresponds to Mathematics A; Physics SL to B and HL to A; Chemistry SL to B and HL to A; English B SL to B; English B HL and English A literature or language/literature SL/HL to A.

claim: DTU distinguishes Course Results entry to BEng from the extra study needed for BSc.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Course Results at least 18 points, grade 3 in six subjects and three HL qualify for BEng; BSc requires at least one supplementary A-level and one B-level subject.
interpretation: DTU says one A-level plus one B-level supplement. The national rule allows two raises to B where an A subject other than Danish is already held and restricts how the general qualification is raised. Seek individual DTU confirmation of an existing or planned Course Results supplement; no automatic acceptance or rejection. Conflict is scoped to this branch.

claim: The national rule distinguishes general qualification supplementation from specific subject supplementation.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Course Results need 18 points, six grades of 3 or more and three HL. University entry requires two later level raises, at least one to A, or two to B when an A subject other than Danish is already held. Use HF single subjects/self-study or accepted foreign equivalents, not GSK to raise the general qualification. Original qualifying Course Results average remains the quota 1 basis. A full Diploma of 24+ qualifies subject to specific requirements.
interpretation: DTU-scoped comparison only. DTU describes A plus B while national guidance includes the existing-A/two-B exception and distinguishes raising qualification from satisfying subjects. Preserve national general evidence unchanged; obtain individual DTU confirmation.

claim: DTU uses optagelse.dk and its own Unistart signature upload.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Opens 1 February; eight applications maximum. Without Danish CPR upload one personally signed PDF signature page per DTU application to UnistartDTU, received by 15 March noon or declined. Postal signatures not accepted. Priorities can change until 5 July noon. DTU emails receipt and updates Unistart.

claim: DTU requires qualification documents and quota 2 supporting material; IB applicants need no statement of hours.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Upload diploma/transcripts; authorised English translation if not English/Nordic. Include higher-education transcripts, supplementary/test results, non-EU passport/residence evidence where applicable, and power of attorney if used. IB exempt from statement of hours. Quota 2 adds English personal statement due 15 March noon, CV and activity evidence. Unistart messages set missing-document deadlines. Generic final-diploma 5 July language is qualified by the separate IB-specific late-diploma page.

claim: DTU publishes annual dates without a confirmed 2027 year.
excerpt: Structured restatement: 1 February opening; IB both quotas apply 15 March noon. Quota 2 personal statement due 15 March noon; supporting documentation 1 April. Final qualification due 5 July noon explicitly excepts IB/EB. Offers 28 July; Unistart reply 3 August. 8 July noon attachments only if specifically requested/allowed. Summer supplement/test results 1 September. Standby text retains 2023/2025: not rolled forward.

claim: Same-year IB applicants arrange DTU results access by 1 June using 173405.
excerpt: Structured restatement: IB-specific page says contact coordinator no later than 1 June and gives 173405 – Technical University of Denmark. Requirements page says before 1 June. Arrange access before 1 June to satisfy both. The 8 July noon diploma upload is expressly EB, not IB. Online release is the stated IB exception to generic 5 July final-diploma wording.

claim: Quota 1 ranks by converted GPA; quota 2 uses motivation, subject results and relevant experience.
excerpt: Structured restatement: IB Diploma eligible for quota 1 GPA ranking. Annual cut-off known on 28 July. Quota 2 uses English motivation letter of 1–2 A4 pages and CV, maths/physics/chemistry results and levels (biology/computer science may count), relevant work/education and other activities. Ongoing activity evidence may be uploaded until quota 1 deadline on this page; dates page says 1 April. Use 1 April unless DTU grants later.

claim: DTU allows conditional subject supplementation in either quota, at most two level raises after 5 July.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Qualifying upper-secondary diploma required by normal qualification deadline, with separate IB online-release exception. Indicate planned supplementary subjects/levels in optagelse.dk. Up to two level raises after 5 July, both quotas. Upload passed exam or English-test results to Unistart by 1 September. Failure does not restore lower priorities. This does not automatically raise Course Results to a general qualification.

claim: DTU current tariff is EUR15,000 annual tuition and EUR100 application fee for liable non-EU/EEA applicants.
excerpt: Structured restatement: EU/EEA tuition state-covered. Most non-EU/EEA pay EUR100 by 15 March before processing; attach receipt. Successful applicants deduct it from first EUR7,500 semester payment (EUR7,400). Certain permanent/qualifying residence permits exempt fees, subject to evidence. Tuition EUR15,000 yearly or EUR7,500 per semester upfront; autumn due 1 August. No undergraduate scholarships/waivers. No 2027 tariff label.

claim: DTU publishes study planning, international student and careers guidance.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Study Guidance helps with course planning, credit/exemptions and regulations. International Student Services covers exchange, administrative and cultural matters; Career Centre offers guidance. International Admissions Office here concerns graduate applicants; bachelor applicants use General Engineering admissions.

claim: DTU offers special educational support for permanent functional impairments.
excerpt: Structured restatement: Contact SPS early; DTU is not automatically notified of prior support. Support needs do not affect admission, records stay confidential and support is not stated on exam certificate. Old 2023 processing dates are not treated as 2027 dates.
